title: Rectify Evaluation Preference: Improving LLMs’ Critique on Math Reasoning via Perplexity-aware Reinforcement Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring LLM critiquing behavior on a custom One-to-many Problem-Solution (OPS) benchmark by calculating a Balance Indicator (difference between False Positive Rate and False Negative Rate) and performing linear regression against solution perplexity to demonstrate that models systematically favor lower-perplexity solutions.
